title: Raising Revenue Right
discussion_signal: The post frames domestic revenue mobilization as a balance between financing development, supporting growth, protecting vulnerable households, and building tax systems that are efficient and fair. Technology, transparency, and trust are presented as part of fiscal capacity rather than administrative afterthoughts.
linked_research_question: How do tax technology, transparency, fairness, and trust shape the legitimacy and capacity of domestic revenue systems?
limits: No taxpayer or country-level implementation evidence is shown
Comments are self-selected and not a representative fiscal debate
